name: La Seu
description: Looks east across the bay to the cathedral, gold at sunset. A balcony over the street.

name: Bellver
description: Looks up the hill to Bellver Castle, round among the pines. The quiet side of the house.

name: Badia
description: Looks over the bay to the western shore, where the sun goes down. Our largest room, on the corner.

name: Tramuntana
description: On the roof, looking north to the Tramuntana range on clear mornings. Small and bright.
